notes.title: How to play this game? [STREAM]
notes.content: The DEMO is now available, but it's pretty rough ːcardsː and we'll be doing our best to explain how to play this game during streams on Saturday and Sunday. The streams will be in English. See you soon, and have fun trying the demo out – the user interface leaves much to be desired, but the mechanics work all right! ːmaliceː
